keys.name: Custody
keys.invariant: Original bytes, source lineage and citations remain resolvable.

keys.name: Authority
keys.invariant: Effects follow actual standing grants and current owner decisions.

keys.name: Semantics
keys.invariant: Types, domains, interpretations and losses stay explicit.

keys.name: State
keys.invariant: Every admitted change has a typed guarded durable transition.

keys.name: Guidance
keys.invariant: Receipt, acknowledgement and actual application are distinct.

keys.name: Evidence
keys.invariant: Claims and completion bind actual evidence of the appropriate class.

keys.name: Continuity
keys.invariant: Historical state and captured bytes remain reconstructible.

keys.name: Construction
keys.invariant: Generated objects have declared rules, derivations and limits.

keys.name: Composition
keys.invariant: Typed joint premises and context survive every composed path.

keys.name: Cost
keys.invariant: Budgets, complexity models and measured resource use are explicit.

keys.name: Evolution
keys.invariant: New versions pass admission without erasing prior versions.

keys.name: Projection
keys.invariant: Human and machine views reflect the same state; reads are pure.

keys.name: Coverage
keys.invariant: Preservation, cataloguing, formalization and verification are measured separately.

keys.name: Language
keys.invariant: Symbols, notation and linguistic relations retain their own domains.

keys.name: Release
keys.invariant: Runnable production and real acceptance determine shipment.

keys.name: University
keys.invariant: Finite commissioning supports continuing bounded scientific inquiry.
